                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Mining now includes the client entry scripts: everything newly found (build 76531814a11d)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The miner now also crawls the client's entry scripts (the legacy web client: modern.vendor, application, rollup-core_*, TS.web), which it never read before, and mines experiments, design tokens, internal paths, hosts and slash commands. Everything below was already in the client; it was just not found until now, so these are one-time additions. Names are matched as strings in the code: a hit means the client mentions it, not that it calls it. 22266 changes since ae84178.
